isaiah: Hear, O heavens. This people is sick. Cease to do evil, learn to do good. Zion shall be redeemed.
The mountain of the Lord. Swords into ploughshares. The day of the Lord against all that is proud.
The Lord will take away support. Children are their oppressors. The daughters of Zion are haughty.
A remnant. The branch of the Lord. A cloud by day, fire by night, over Mount Zion.
A love-song for a vineyard. Woe to those who join house to house, who call evil good.
In the year king Uzziah died. Holy, holy, holy. A coal. Here I am; send me. A remnant, a stump.
Ahaz. A sign: a virgin shall conceive. Immanuel. The land whose two kings you dread will be deserted.
Maher-shalal-hash-baz. Do not walk in the way of this people. Bind up the testimony.
A child is born. The government on his shoulder. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will do this.
Woe to those who decree iniquitous decrees. A remnant will return. A remnant of Jacob.
A shoot from the stump of Jesse. The Spirit of the Lord. The wolf and the lamb. A signal for the peoples.
You will say in that day: I will give thanks. God is my salvation. Wells of salvation.
An oracle concerning Babylon. The day of the Lord is near. Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, like Sodom.
A taunt over the king of Babylon. How you are fallen from heaven, O Day Star. Philistia, do not rejoice.
An oracle concerning Moab. In a night Ar of Moab is laid waste. A throne established in steadfast love.
An oracle concerning Damascus. The remnant of Aram. In that day people will look to their Maker.
An oracle concerning Ethiopia. Go, you swift messengers. A people tall and smooth.
An oracle concerning Egypt. The Lord riding on a swift cloud. Egypt, Assyria, and Israel, a blessing.
A sign against Egypt and Cush. Naked and barefoot. Those who hoped in them will be dismayed.
A stern vision: Babylon is fallen. Dumah. Arabia. Watchman, what time of the night?
The valley of vision. Shebna. Eliakim. I will place on his shoulder the key of the house of David.
An oracle concerning Tyre. Wail, O ships of Tarshish. Tyre will be forgotten seventy years.
The earth is utterly broken. A curse has devoured the earth. The Lord of hosts reigns on Mount Zion.
O Lord, you are my God. He will swallow up death forever. The hand of the Lord will rest on this mountain.
A vineyard of wine, a song of the beloved. He will slay Leviathan. Israel shall blossom and fill the world with fruit.
A strong city. Open the gates. Your dead shall live. Hide yourselves for a little while until the fury has passed.
Leviathan. A pleasant vineyard. Israel shall blossom and fill the world with fruit. The lost gathered.
Woe to the proud crown of the drunkards of Ephraim. A precious cornerstone. Precept upon precept.
Ariel. I will again do wonderful things. This people draw near with their mouth. The deaf shall hear.
Woe to the rebellious children who go down to Egypt. In returning and rest you shall be saved.
Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help. The Assyrian shall fall by a sword not of man.
A king will reign in righteousness. The Spirit poured out. The work of righteousness will be peace.
Woe to you, destroyer. The Lord is exalted, for he dwells on high. Your eyes will see the king in his beauty.
Draw near, you nations. The Lord's sword. Edom. The year of recompense for the cause of Zion.
The wilderness and the dry land shall be glad. A highway. The ransomed of the Lord shall return.
Sennacherib. The Rabshakeh’s speech. Do not let Hezekiah deceive you.
Hezekiah’s men, silent. Isaiah’s word. The king of Assyria shall not come into this city.
Hezekiah’s prayer. The angel of the Lord. 185,000. Sennacherib at home, killed by his sons.
Hezekiah’s illness. A sign of the shadow. A writing of Hezekiah after he had been sick.
Merodach-baladan’s envoys. All that is in your house shall be carried to Babylon.
Comfort, comfort my people. A voice in the wilderness. The word of our God will stand forever.
Behold my servant. A bruised reed he will not break. Sing to the Lord a new song.
But now thus says the Lord who created you, O Jacob. When you pass through the waters. I am the Lord, your Holy One.
Fear not, my servant Jacob. I will pour my Spirit upon your offspring. There is no other god.
Thus says the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus. I form light and create darkness. Turn to me and be saved, all the ends of the earth.
Bel bows down. I have made, and I will bear. I am God, and there is no other. My counsel shall stand.
Come down and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon. You felt secure in your wickedness.
Hear this, O house of Jacob. I am the first and I am the last. Go out from Babylon.
Listen to me, O coastlands. The Lord called me from the womb. A light for the nations. Can a woman forget her nursing child?
Where is your mother’s certificate of divorce? The Lord God has given me the tongue of those who are taught. Who among you fears the Lord?
Look to Abraham. The Lord will comfort Zion. Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the Lord.
Awake, awake, put on your strength, O Zion. How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news.
Who has believed what he has heard from us? A man of sorrows. He was pierced for our transgressions. He shall see his offspring.
Sing, O barren one. Enlarge the place of your tent. All your children shall be taught by the Lord.
Come, everyone who thirsts. Seek the Lord while he may be found. My word shall not return to me empty.
Keep justice. The foreigner who joins himself to the Lord. A house of prayer for all peoples.
The righteous perish. The wicked are like the tossing sea. Build up, build up, prepare the way.
Cry aloud; do not hold back. Is not this the fast that I choose: to loose the bonds of wickedness.
Your iniquities have made a separation. He put on righteousness as a breastplate. A Redeemer will come to Zion.
Arise, shine, for your light has come. Nations shall come to your light. Your sun shall no more go down.
The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me. Good news to the poor. The year of the Lord’s favour. You shall be called priests of the Lord.
For Zion’s sake I will not keep silent. Your land shall be married. Who is this who comes from Edom.
I will recount the steadfast love of the Lord. You, O Lord, are our Father. We are the clay.
Oh that you would rend the heavens. We have all become like one who is unclean. Will you restrain yourself, O Lord?
I was ready to be sought. Here I am, here I am. New heavens and a new earth. The wolf and the lamb shall graze together.
Heaven is my throne. This is the one to whom I will look: he who is humble and contrite. They shall go out and look on the corpses. Their worm shall not die.
jeremiah: The call. Before I formed you in the womb I knew you. A prophet to the nations. To pluck up and to plant.
I remember the devotion of your youth. My people have committed two evils: broken cisterns.
Faithless Israel. Return, faithless children. I will give you shepherds after my own heart.
If you return, O Israel. Circumcise yourselves to the Lord. Disaster from the north.
Run to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem. They have refused to take correction. Shall I not punish them?
Flee for safety, O people of Benjamin. They have healed the wound of my people lightly. Stand by the roads, and ask for the ancient paths.
The temple sermon. Do not trust in these deceptive words: this is the temple of the Lord. Amend your ways.
At that time, declares the Lord, they shall bring out the bones. The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
Oh that my head were waters. They refuse to know me. Let not the wise man boast in his wisdom.
Learn not the way of the nations. There is none like you, O Lord. It is he who made the earth.
The covenant broken. Therefore I will bring disaster. Do not pray for this people.
Why does the way of the wicked prosper? If you have raced with men on foot. I have forsaken my house.
A linen loincloth, spoiled. Every jar filled with wine. Give glory to the Lord before he brings darkness.
Judah mourns. Do not pray for this people. I will not accept them. Oh that I had in the desert a travellers’ lodging.
You shall not take a wife. This people will die of deadly diseases. If you return, I will restore you.
You shall not enter a house of mourning. I have taken away my peace from this people. I will make you a bronze wall.
The sabbath. If you listen, this city shall be inhabited forever. If you do not, I will kindle a fire.
The potter’s house. Can I not do with you as this potter has done? A plot against Jeremiah.
A flask broken. Topheth. Pashhur strikes Jeremiah. Terror on every side.
O Lord, you have deceived me. Cursed be the day on which I was born. Why did I come out from the womb.
Zedekiah’s inquiry. I have set before you the way of life and the way of death. O land, land, land, hear the word of the Lord.
Shallum. Jehoiakim’s palace of injustice. Coniah as a signet ring torn off.
Woe to the shepherds. A righteous Branch. False prophets. Am I a God at hand, and not a God far away?
Two baskets of figs. The good figs: I will give them a heart to know me. The bad: I will make them a horror.
Twenty-three years I have spoken. This whole land shall become a ruin. Seventy years. Then I will punish the king of Babylon.
Do not listen to the prophets. This house shall be like Shiloh. Jeremiah on trial. Ahikam.
Bonds and yokes. Serve the king of Babylon and live. Hananiah breaks the yoke. He dies that year.
A letter to the exiles. Seek the welfare of the city. When seventy years are completed, I will visit you.
Shemaiah of Nehelam. You have not sent him. I will punish Shemaiah and his descendants.
I will restore the fortunes of my people. In the latter days you will understand. Jacob’s trouble.
At that time I will be the God of all the clans of Israel. A new covenant. I will write it on their hearts.
Jeremiah imprisoned. He buys a field. Houses and fields and vineyards shall again be bought in this land.
The word of the Lord came a second time. I will restore their fortunes. The voice of mirth, the voice of the bride.
Zedekiah. The sabbath year and slaves taken back. You have not obeyed me by proclaiming liberty.
The Rechabites. Jonadab’s command kept. This people has not obeyed me. Jonadab shall never lack a man to stand before me.
In the fourth year of Jehoiakim. Baruch writes the scroll. Jehudi reads. The king cuts it and burns it. Another scroll.
Zedekiah made king. Jeremiah’s word: you shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon. I will not see you again — not yet.
The officials. Jeremiah in the cistern. Ebed-melech. Zedekiah’s last interview. He is afraid of the Judeans.
The city is taken. Zedekiah’s eyes. Jeremiah released. Stay with Gedaliah.
Gedaliah at Mizpah. Ishmael murders him. Johanan. Do not go to Egypt.
Johanan refuses. We will go to Egypt. Jeremiah taken. You shall die there.
In Tahpanhes. Pharaoh’s palace. I will set my throne upon these stones. Egypt given to Nebuchadnezzar.
A word to the Judeans in Egypt. The queen of heaven. They will not listen. A remnant shall return — a few.
Baruch: do you seek great things for yourself? Seek them not. I will give you your life as a prize of war.
The word concerning the nations. Concerning Egypt. Pharaoh is but a noise.
Concerning the Philistines. A flood from the north. Baldness has come upon Gaza.
Concerning Moab. Moab is destroyed. Yet I will restore the fortunes of Moab in the latter days.
Concerning Ammon, Edom, Damascus, Kedar, Elam. I will restore the fortunes of Elam.
The word concerning Babylon. Flee from the midst of Babylon. A golden cup in the Lord’s hand.
Thus says the Lord: behold, I will stir up the spirit of a destroyer against Babylon. Jeremiah’s scroll sunk in the Euphrates.
Zedekiah’s eleventh year. The city taken. The temple burned. The people exiled. Gedaliah. Jehoiachin’s elevation in Babylon.
The last scene again, in the chronicler’s voice: the poor of the land left as vinedressers; Jehoiachin brought out of prison in the thirty-seventh year.
lamentations: How lonely sits the city. She that was great among the nations. Zion’s roads mourn. See, O Lord, my affliction.
The Lord has swallowed up without mercy. The Lord has become like an enemy. Arise, cry out in the night. Pour out your heart like water.
I am the man who has seen affliction. Great is your faithfulness. It is good that one should wait quietly. Let us test and examine our ways.
The holy stones lie scattered. The tongue of the nursing infant sticks to the roof of its mouth. Rejoice, O daughter of Edom — the cup will pass to you.
Remember, O Lord, what has befallen us. Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers. Restore us to yourself, O Lord, that we may be restored.
ezekiel: By the Chebar. A storm, living creatures, wheels, a throne. The appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord.
Son of man, stand. I send you to a rebellious house. Eat this scroll. It was sweet as honey.
Whether they hear or refuse. A watchman. The hand of the Lord strong upon me. I sat overwhelmed seven days.
A brick. A siege. Lie on your left side 390 days, on your right 40. Bread baked on dung.
A sword. A third to pestilence, a third to the sword, a third to the wind. I will be known in the eyes of the nations.
To the mountains of Israel. Your altars shall become desolate. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
The end has come. I will judge you according to your ways. The day is near.
In the sixth year. A hole in the wall. Seventy elders, creeping things, women weeping for Tammuz, men toward the sun.
Six men with weapons. A man with a writing case. Mark those who sigh. Begin at my sanctuary.
The glory rises from the cherub. Wheels. I will give them one heart. The glory stood over the east gate.
Twenty-five men. Pelatiah dies. I will be a sanctuary to them for a little while in the countries where they have gone.
Baggage for exile. Dig through the wall. I am a sign for you. Every vision comes to nothing — they say. It will be fulfilled.
Foolish prophets. Whitewash. Daughters who sew magic bands. You hunt souls.
Certain elders. Should I let myself be consulted by them? Though Noah, Daniel, and Job were in it, they would deliver only their own lives.
A useless vine. Fit for the fire. So I have given up the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
An origin in Canaan. An allegory of unfaithfulness. Yet I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth.
Two eagles and a vine. Zedekiah’s oath broken. I will take a sprig from the lofty cedar.
The soul who sins shall die. A son shall not suffer for the father’s iniquity. Turn, and live.
A lamentation for the princes of Israel. A lioness. A vine plucked up. No strong branch left.
The elders again. I will not be inquired of by you. I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.
A sword sharpened. The king of Babylon at the fork. Mark the way. A rod of wickedness.
The bloody city. Dross in the furnace. I will scatter you among the nations.
Oholah and Oholibah. Samaria and Jerusalem. The cup of your sister.
The siege begun. A rusted pot. Ezekiel’s wife dies. You shall not mourn. I am a sign.
A word against Ammon, Moab, Edom, Philistia. I will execute judgments.
A word against Tyre. Because you said, Aha. I am against you, O Tyre.
A lament over Tyre. A merchant of the peoples. You were in Eden — the king of Tyre.
A word against Sidon. Then they will dwell securely. A word against Pharaoh: a staff of reed.
Pharaoh the dragon in the Nile. I will put hooks in your jaws. Egypt a desolation forty years.
A lament. Assyria a cedar in Lebanon. Pharaoh, you are like this. Down to Sheol.
A watchman again. The wicked who turns shall live. Your people say the way of the Lord is not just.
Shepherds of Israel who feed themselves. I myself will search for my sheep. One shepherd, my servant David.
Mount Seir. Because you cherished perpetual enmity. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
Prophesy to the mountains of Israel. I will sprinkle clean water. A heart of flesh. I will put my Spirit within you.
The valley of dry bones. Can these bones live? Two sticks, Judah and Joseph, one in my hand.
Gog of the land of Magog. In the latter years you will come against the land. I will show my greatness.
On the mountains of Israel he shall fall. Seven months of burying. A great sacrificial feast.
In the twenty-fifth year. A vision of a temple. A man with a measuring reed. The wall.
The east gate. The nave. The most holy place. Cherubim and palm trees.
Chambers for the priests. The wall all around. The law of the temple: the whole territory shall be most holy.
The glory of the God of Israel came from the east. The glory filled the temple. Son of man, this is the place of my throne.
The east gate shut. The prince. No uncircumcised in heart shall enter. The priests the sons of Zadok.
The priests’ portions. The prince’s portion. Honest measures. Firstfruits.
The prince and the feasts. Passover. The east gate opened on the sabbath.
Water from below the threshold. A river that cannot be crossed. Trees for food, leaves for healing. The Dead Sea made fresh.
The boundaries of the land. Twelve tribes. Aliens who sojourn shall have an inheritance.
The portions. The holy district. The city. Twelve gates named for the tribes.
The gates again. The name of the city from that day shall be: The Lord Is There.
daniel: Young men in Babylon. Vegetables and water. God gave them learning. Ten times better.
Nebuchadnezzar’s dream. A statue of gold, silver, bronze, iron, clay. A stone not cut by hands. God of gods.
A golden image. The furnace heated seven times. Four men walking. The fourth like a son of the gods.
A tree cut down. Seven times. Nebuchadnezzar eats grass. His reason returns. Those who walk in pride he is able to humble.
Belshazzar’s feast. A hand. Mene, mene, tekel, parsin. That night the king was killed.
The den of lions. The law of the Medes and Persians. My God sent his angel. Daniel prospered.
Four beasts. The Ancient of Days. One like a son of man. The saints of the Most High shall receive the kingdom.
A ram and a goat. The little horn. 2,300 evenings and mornings. Seal up the vision.
Daniel’s prayer. We have sinned. Seventy weeks. To finish the transgression. A most holy place.
A man clothed in linen. I was left alone. Fear not, Daniel, greatly loved. The prince of Persia withstood me.
Three more kings. A warrior king. The king of the south and the north. The abomination that makes desolate.
At that time Michael shall arise. Many who sleep in the dust shall awake. Go your way till the end. You shall rest.
hosea: Go, take to yourself a wife of whoredom. Jezreel. I will break the bow of Israel.
No Mercy. Not My People. Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be like the sand. You are my people.
Go again, love a woman. Many days without king or sacrifice. Afterward the children of Israel shall return.
There is no faithfulness or steadfast love. My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. A spirit of whoredom.
Hear this, O priests. I will return again to my place, until they acknowledge their guilt and seek my face.
Come, let us return to the Lord. He has torn, and he will heal. I desire steadfast love and not sacrifice.
When I would heal Israel, the iniquity of Ephraim is revealed. They do not cry to me from the heart.
Set the trumpet to your lips. They have become like any other nation. How long will they be incapable of innocence?
Rejoice not, O Israel. The days of punishment have come. Ephraim’s glory shall fly away like a bird.
Israel is a luxuriant vine. They shall say to the mountains, Cover us. I will destroy the king of Israel.
When Israel was a child, I loved him. How can I give you up, O Ephraim? I am God and not a man.
Ephraim feeds on the wind. The Lord has an indictment against Judah. By a prophet the Lord brought Israel up from Egypt.
When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling. I am like a green pine tree; from me comes your fruit. Whoever is wise, let him understand.
Return, O Israel. Take with you words. I will heal their apostasy; I will love them freely. They shall blossom like the lily.
joel: Hear this, you elders. What the cutting locust left, the swarming locust has eaten. Rend your hearts. Return to the Lord.
Blow a trumpet in Zion. The day of the Lord is coming. I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
In those days I will restore the fortunes of Judah. The valley of Jehoshaphat. The Lord roars from Zion. Judah shall abide forever.
amos: The Lord roars from Zion. For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four. Gaza, Tyre, Edom, Ammon.
Moab. Judah. Israel — because they sell the righteous for silver. You only have I known; therefore I will punish you.
Do two walk together unless they have agreed. The lion has roared; who will not fear. Hear this word, you cows of Bashan.
Hear this word. Come to Bethel, and transgress. I gave you cleanness of teeth. Prepare to meet your God, O Israel.
Hear this word. Seek me and live. Let justice roll down like waters, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream.
Woe to those who are at ease in Zion. You who put far away the day of disaster. I will raise up a nation against you.
He showed me: locusts, fire, a plumb line. I will never again pass by them. Amaziah the priest of Bethel.
A basket of summer fruit. The end has come. I will send a famine of hearing the words of the Lord.
I saw the Lord standing beside the altar. Though they dig into Sheol. In that day I will raise up the booth of David. I will plant them upon their land.
obadiah: The vision of Obadiah. Edom. You who live in the clefts of the rock. As you have done, it shall be done to you. The kingdom shall be the Lord’s.
jonah: The word of the Lord: arise, go to Nineveh. Jonah flees to Tarshish. A storm. A lot. Into the sea.
Jonah prayed from the belly of the fish. I called out of my distress. Salvation belongs to the Lord. The fish vomited him out.
Arise, go to Nineveh. Yet forty days. The people believed God. The king, sackcloth, even the beasts. God relented.
It displeased Jonah exceedingly. A plant, a worm, a scorching east wind. Should I not pity Nineveh, that great city — and also much cattle.
micah: The word concerning Samaria and Jerusalem. The mountains will melt. Declare it not in Gath. For this I will lament.
Woe to those who devise wickedness and work evil on their beds. They covet fields and seize them. I will surely assemble all of you, O Jacob.
Hear, you heads of Jacob. Is it not for you to know justice. Zion shall be ploughed as a field.
It shall come to pass in the latter days. Swords into ploughshares. A remnant. The Lord will reign over them in Mount Zion.
From you, O Bethlehem Ephrathah, shall come forth one who is to be ruler in Israel. He shall be their peace.
Hear what the Lord says. With what shall I come before the Lord. He has told you, O man, what is good: do justice, love kindness, walk humbly.
Woe is me. A son treats his father with contempt. But as for me, I will look to the Lord. Who is a God like you, pardoning iniquity.
nahum: An oracle concerning Nineveh. The Lord is a jealous and avenging God. Slow to anger, great in power. The Lord is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble.
The scatterer has come up against you. The chariots race. Behold, I am against you, declares the Lord of hosts.
Woe to the bloody city. All who hear the news about you clap their hands over you. For upon whom has not come your unceasing evil.
habakkuk: O Lord, how long shall I cry for help. You will not hear. I am raising up the Chaldeans. They laugh at every fortress.
I will take my stand at my watchpost. The righteous shall live by his faith. Woe to him who heaps up what is not his own.
A prayer of Habakkuk. O Lord, I have heard the report of you. Though the fig tree should not blossom, yet I will rejoice in the Lord.
zephaniah: The word in the days of Josiah. I will utterly sweep away everything. The great day of the Lord is near. A day of wrath, a day of distress.
Gather together, O shameless nation. Seek the Lord, all you humble of the land. Gaza shall be deserted. Moab like Sodom. The remnant of my people shall plunder them.
Woe to her who is rebellious. The Lord within her is righteous. Sing aloud, O daughter of Zion. The Lord your God is in your midst. He will rejoice over you with gladness.
haggai: In the second year of Darius. Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your panelled houses, while this house lies in ruins. Consider your ways. They came and worked on the house of the Lord.
Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory. Take courage. The latter glory of this house shall be greater. I will take you, O Zerubbabel, and make you like a signet ring.
zechariah: In the eighth month. Return to me, and I will return to you. Do not be like your fathers. The Lord was very angry with your fathers.
A man among the myrtle trees. How long will you have no mercy on Jerusalem. I am exceedingly jealous for Zion.
Four horns. Four craftsmen. A man with a measuring line. Jerusalem shall be inhabited as villages without walls.
Joshua the high priest. Satan standing at his right hand. I have taken your iniquity away. The Branch.
A lampstand of gold. Two olive trees. Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit. The hands of Zerubbabel shall finish this house.
A flying scroll. A woman in a basket: Wickedness. Two women with wings like a stork.
Four chariots. The four winds of heaven. A crown on Joshua. Behold, the man whose name is the Branch.
In the fourth year. Should I weep in the fifth month. Render true judgments, show kindness. Did not my words overtake your fathers.
I will return to Zion. Old men and old women in the streets. Boys and girls playing. I will save my people from the east country and from the west.
A heavy burden. Ask rain from the Lord. The household gods utter nonsense. I will make them strong in the Lord.
Open your doors, O Lebanon. Woe to my worthless shepherd. Three shepherds in one month. Thirty pieces of silver. The Lord said, throw it to the potter.
The oracle of the word of the Lord concerning Israel. I will make Jerusalem a cup of staggering. They will look on me, on him whom they have pierced.
On that day a fountain shall be opened. Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered. Two thirds shall be cut off. I will refine them as silver is refined.
A day is coming for the Lord. Living waters shall flow from Jerusalem. The Lord will be king over all the earth. Holy to the Lord on the bells of the horses.
malachi: The oracle of the word of the Lord to Israel. I have loved you. Where is my honour. O priests who despise my name. Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors.
And now, O priests, this command is for you. Judah has been faithless. The Lord was witness between you and the wife of your youth. I hate divorce.

Behold, I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me. The Lord whom you seek will suddenly come to his temple. Return to me. Bring the full tithe. Those who feared the Lord spoke with one another.
For behold, the day is coming, burning like an oven. But for you who fear my name, the sun of righteousness shall rise. Remember the law of Moses. Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet.
